svg.title: Meridian House — Level 2 Escape Plan
svg.desc: A posted escape and evacuation plan for one office floor, drawn to ISO 23601. A grey line-work floor plan shows ten rooms either side of a central corridor with a protected stair at each end. A blue bull's-eye marks the reader's own position in the open office; a bold green band runs from it to the east stair and out to the assembly point in the car park, and a dashed green band runs the other way to the west stair, each carrying white chevrons pointing away from the reader. Green ISO 7010 plates mark the two final exits and the two exit-direction signs, red plates mark two fire extinguishers and the fire alarm call point, and a green cross marks the first-aid point in the break room. A north arrow, a scale bar, a title block and a boxed legend listing every symbol used complete the sheet.
